credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/ghostpipe.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LOOMING: a clump of five waxy pipes fanning out of the leaf litter, the bells nodding at every angle (one half-lifted). Gesture: the heads dip, then four LIFT upright together (as the real plant does when it fruits; one short pipe stays nodding), sway, and settle back. WHITE: ghost pipe has no chlorophyll, so the whole plant is waxy white; the lilac light slot shades the wax and the violet dark slot carries the form and the leaf litter. Sport: the natural pink form.
